verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents an EU Data Residency Program allowing customers to process and store personal data in Europe, directly addressing regional data residency choice [mixpanel-docs-38], backed by GDPR-oriented deletion/retrieval APIs [mixpanel-docs-12]. Missing for 10: no detail on which regions beyond EU are supported, no independent/hands-on confirmation of the residency mechanics or migration process, and no mention of per-project region selection UI.
